first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: A yellow low-slung sports car in the foreground, with a dark rear panel, a large dark-red rear wing, and red ring-shaped taillights.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: A white low-slung sports car ahead of Vehicle A, with a dark horizontal component above the rear and horizontally arranged bright taillight points.

entities.name: racetrack surface
entities.identification: The broad gray paved main surface extending from the lower and right parts of the image toward the distant gantry.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The blue-gray sky above the trees and mountain, brighter near the horizon.

entities.name: orange-lit tunnel entrance
entities.identification: The arched orange-yellow brightly lit entrance area among the trees at the far end of the racetrack.

entities.name: red-and-white curb
entities.identification: The red-and-white segmented curb repeatedly arranged along the road outside the left boundary of the racetrack.

entities.name: green runoff area
entities.identification: The green strip-shaped paved area to the left of the red-and-white curb.

entities.name: concrete racetrack barrier
entities.identification: The low, solid gray wall extending continuously along the racetrack on the left side of the image.

entities.name: metal racetrack guardrail
entities.identification: The continuous guardrail on the right side of the road, composed of multiple silver-gray parallel horizontal members.

entities.name: racetrack safety fence
entities.identification: The mesh fence supported by repeated tall gray posts above the left-side barrier.

entities.name: trees around the outside of the racetrack
entities.identification: The dense dark-green trees on both sides of the road and in the distance, with crowns of varying heights.

entities.name: distant mountain
entities.identification: The gray-green ridge and partially visible light-gray mountainside exposed behind the trees in the upper left at the beginning of the clip.

entities.name: racetrack grandstand
entities.identification: The gray tiered stepped structure behind the safety fence on the left at the beginning of the clip.

entities.name: racetrack sign and display screen
entities.identification: The original set of facilities consisting of the large illuminated display screen on the right, the long advertising boards on the left, and the vertical signs beside the distant gantry.

entities.name: roadside lattice tower
entities.identification: The slender gray lattice tower exposed above the trees on the right, with multiple tiers of horizontal members on its upper section.

entities.name: gantry spanning the racetrack
entities.identification: The dark crossbeam spanning the road in front of the entrance and the vertical support structures on both sides.

entities.name: roadside grass
entities.identification: The low green-brown strip of grass between the left-side barrier and the roadside paved area.
